params.prompt: Photorealistic YouTube thumbnail portrait of Kim Jong Un, head and shoulders, facing the camera, head filling the frame, cropped at the chest, centered, dark Mao-style suit. A knowing, self-satisfied closed-mouth smirk, slightly narrowed eyes, confident. Background: a plain dark-grey smoky gradient like the reference image, soft smoke, nothing else behind him. No text, no letters, no logos, no building, no sky, no flag. Cinematic front lighting with catchlights in the eyes, skin detail, sharp focus. Lit a little from the upper left for drama, the smoke slightly brighter behind the head so the face pops, head tilted a few degrees, the sly smile restrained.
